statement: When mailing important information about drugs to physicians and others responsible for patient care, prepare the mailing to the FDA distinctive-mailing specifications: first class mail in No. 10 white envelopes, sender name and address in the upper left corner, and the applicable boxed statement on the far left third of the envelope front.
quote: Manufacturers and distributors of drugs are asked to make such mailings as prescribed by this section
condition: when mailing important drug information
findings: 10 in the statement, not in the quote or its parent paragraphs

statement: Do not use the distinctive envelopes reserved for important drug information mailings for ordinary mail.
quote: not to use the distinctive envelopes for ordinary mail

statement: When mailing important drug information to physicians and others responsible for patient care, send it by first class mail in No. 10 white envelopes.
quote: Use first class mail and No. 10 white envelopes.
condition: when mailing important drug information

statement: When mailing important drug information, show the name and address of the drug manufacturer or distributor in the upper left corner of the envelope.
quote: The name and address of the agency or the drug manufacturer or distributor is to appear in the upper left corner of the envelope.
condition: when mailing important drug information

statement: When mailing important drug information, place the applicable prescribed statement in the far left third of the envelope front, in the type and size indicated, centered in a rectangle about 3 inches wide and 2 1/4 inches high with a border about 3/8 inch wide in the indicated color.
quote: The following statements are to appear in the far left third of the envelope front, in the type and size indicated, centered in a rectangular space approximately 3 inches wide and 2 1/4 inches high with an approximately 3/8 inch-wide border in the color indicated:
condition: when mailing important drug information

statement: When the mailed information concerns a significant hazard to health, print the prescribed hazard statement in the far left third of the envelope front, in the indicated type and size, centered in a rectangle about 3 inches wide and 2 1/4 inches high with a border about 3/8 inch wide in the indicated color.
quote: When the information concerns a significant hazard to health, the statement:
condition: information concerns a significant hazard to health

statement: When the mailed information concerns important changes in drug package labeling, print the prescribed labeling-change statement in the far left third of the envelope front, in the indicated type and size, centered in a rectangle about 3 inches wide and 2 1/4 inches high with a border about 3/8 inch wide in the indicated color.
quote: When the information concerns important changes in drug package labeling, the statement:
condition: information concerns important changes in drug package labeling

statement: When the mailed information concerns a correction of prescription drug advertising or labeling, print the prescribed correction statement in the far left third of the envelope front, in the indicated type and size, centered in a rectangle about 3 inches wide and 2 1/4 inches high with a border about 3/8 inch wide in the indicated color.
quote: When the information concerns a correction of prescription drug advertising or labeling, the statement:
condition: information concerns a correction of prescription drug advertising or labeling

statement: Printed indications and dosage information supplied to pharmacists should not be displayed to prospective purchasers to promote over-the-counter sale of prescription drugs.
quote: Obviously, such printed matter should not be displayed to prospective purchasers to promote over-the-counter sale of prescription drugs.
condition: printed matter supplied to pharmacists

statement: Octadecylamine may be used in steam lines where the steam may be used for autoclaving surgical instruments and gauze only if its level in the steam is not more than 2.4 parts per million.
quote: The Food and Drug Administration will not object to the use of octadecylamine in steam lines where the steam may be used for autoclaving surgical instruments and gauze if the octadecylamine in the steam is not more than 2.4 parts per million.
condition: steam may be used for autoclaving surgical instruments and gauze

statement: All preparations offered or intended for ophthalmic use, including preparations for cleansing the eyes, should be sterile.
quote: Informed medical opinion is in agreement that all preparations offered or intended for ophthalmic use, including preparations for cleansing the eyes, should be sterile.
condition: preparations for ophthalmic use

statement: Containers of ophthalmic preparations are sterile at the time of filling and closing.
quote: The containers of ophthalmic preparations shall be sterile at the time of filling and closing
condition: ophthalmic preparations

statement: The container or individual carton of ophthalmic preparations is sealed so that the contents cannot be used without destroying the seal.
quote: the container or individual carton shall be so sealed that the contents cannot be used without destroying the seal
condition: ophthalmic preparations

statement: Packaging and labeling of over-the-counter ophthalmic preparations also comply with the FDA tamper-resistant packaging requirements for over-the-counter drug products.
quote: The packaging and labeling of ophthalmic preparations that are over-the-counter drugs shall also comply with § 211.132 of this chapter on tamper-resistant packaging requirements.
condition: ophthalmic preparations that are over-the-counter drugs

statement: Liquid ophthalmic preparations packed in multiple-dose containers should contain one or more suitable and harmless substances that inhibit the growth of microorganisms, or alternatively be packaged and labeled as described in the next item.
quote: Contain one or more suitable and harmless substances that will inhibit the growth of microorganisms; or
condition: liquid ophthalmic preparations in multiple-dose containers

statement: Liquid ophthalmic preparations packed in multiple-dose containers should, as the alternative to containing a suitable antimicrobial substance, be packaged as to container volume and type and labeled as to duration of use and with necessary warnings so as to give adequate protection and minimize the hazard of injury from contamination during use.
quote: Be so packaged as to volume and type of container and so labeled as to duration of use and with such necessary warnings as to afford adequate protection and minimize the hazard of injury resulting from contamination during use.
condition: liquid ophthalmic preparations in multiple-dose containers

statement: Eye cups, eye droppers and other dispensers intended for ophthalmic use should be sterile.
quote: Eye cups, eye droppers, and other dispensers intended for ophthalmic use should be sterile
condition: dispensers intended for ophthalmic use

statement: Eye cups, eye droppers and other ophthalmic dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with should be packaged so that sterility is maintained until the package is opened.
quote: should be packaged so as to maintain sterility until the package is opened
condition: dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with

statement: Eye cups, eye droppers and other ophthalmic dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with should be labeled, on or within the retail package, with adequate directions and necessary warnings to minimize the hazard of injury from contamination during use.
quote: be labeled, on or within the retail package, so as to afford adequate directions and necessary warnings to minimize the hazard of injury resulting from contamination during use
condition: dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with

statement: Manufacture all aqueous-based drug products for oral inhalation to be sterile.
quote: All aqueous-based drug products for oral inhalation must be manufactured to be sterile.
condition: aqueous-based drug products for oral inhalation

statement: For aqueous-based drug products for oral inhalation, also establish and follow written procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile, including validation of all aseptic and sterilization processes.
quote: Manufacturers must also comply with the requirements in § 211.113(b) of this chapter.
condition: aqueous-based drug products for oral inhalation
